metadata.description: The Python client's walk and journey against a real supervisor and OctoPrint. Its one expensive target, test-integration, is never selected by an affected run: just test-integration runs it through nx run-many over every project on every pull request, whatever a change reaches, so an edge here selects only this project's format, lint and type checks. Its edges are the code's: the client it drives, and repo-checks, whose expect and shell modules it imports as every suite here does.

typecheck.command: uv run -q ty check --extra-search-path python/printobserver-sdk/integration python/printobserver-sdk/integration && uv run -q ty check --python-platform win32 --extra-search-path python/printobserver-sdk/integration python/printobserver-sdk/integration
